overviewParagraphs: Taekwang Jeongsan Country Club occupies a unique position in Vietnam's golf landscape — literally. Situated on a river island south of Ho Chi Minh City, the club is accessible exclusively by private speedboat from the Saigon River pier, making the journey to the first tee a uniquely cinematic experience.

Designed by Ron Fream of Golfplan, the layout is known for its use of challenging, strategic bunkering and strong par-4 corridors through dense tropical vegetation. The course offers a private, exclusive atmosphere that stands in sharp contrast to the busier resort circuits around the city.

Taekwang Jeongsan caters to a discerning clientele seeking a private-members experience in southern Vietnam. For the discerning golf traveller who has played the standard Saigon circuit, this destination offers something genuinely different and memorable.

curatorBriefHtml: Taekwang Jeongsan Country Club delivers one of the most memorable arrivals in Southeast Asian golf: a breezy 30-minute private speedboat ride up the Saigon River directly from District 1 to Dai Phuoc Island. Designed by Ron Fream’s Golfplan studio (Par 72, 7,174 yards), the 18-hole layout is split into the scenic Sun Nine and water-wrapped Moon Nine, offering peaceful island golf completely removed from Ho Chi Minh City’s traffic.

Having played Taekwang Jeongsan personally, the speedboat transfer alone turns a standard Saigon golf day into an event clients talk about for years — bypassing road congestion completely and dropping you steps from the riverside clubhouse. On the course, wide Paspalum fairways invite aggressive driving, while shifting river breezes and strategic water hazards around the greens keep scoring honest.
Taekwang Jeongsan is an effortless highlight on any Ho Chi Minh City stay based at The Caravelle or Park Hyatt Saigon, pairing cleanly with Long Thanh and The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram.

scorecard.gradeBadge: Saigon River Island Golf • Dai Phuoc
scorecard.verdict: Located on Dai Phuoc Island on the Dong Nai River, accessible by direct boat from downtown Saigon. A tranquil island layout offering firm greens, cooling breezes, and great dining.

faqs.q: How does the speedboat transfer to Taekwang Jeongsan work?
faqs.a: Instead of sitting in Saigon road traffic, AGS coordinates a direct 25- to 30-minute boat crossing from central Ho Chi Minh City’s river pier straight to Dai Phuoc Island’s clubhouse jetty — with your golf clubs handled door-to-door.

faqs.q: What is the course layout like at Taekwang Jeongsan Country Club?
faqs.a: Designed by Golfplan / Ron Fream (Par 72, 7,174 yards), the course splits into the Sun and Moon nines across flat island terrain bordered by river channels. Generous fairways make it welcoming for resort golfers, while island breezes and water-protected greens test approach precision.

faqs.q: Is Taekwang Jeongsan also accessible by road?
faqs.a: Yes — road access is available via Dong Nai (roughly 60–75 minutes from District 1), though the scenic Saigon River speedboat is faster and far more memorable.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Taekwang Jeongsan?
faqs.a: December through April brings dry, sunny Southern Vietnam mornings and calm river crossings. During May–November, morning tee times beat afternoon tropical showers.
